title: COVID-19 Vaccines: MODERNA | PFIZER/BIONTECH | ASTRAZENECA
summary: A Ninja Nerd whiteboard lecture on the Moderna, Pfizer/BioNTech and AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccines. It covers how each works, the preclinical and phase I-III trial process, and Operation Warp Speed.
why: HN recommended it in late 2020 as a detailed, science-based explanation of how the different vaccines work and how they were tested.

quote.text: This is the best science based informative video I have seen on how these different Covid vaccines actually work.
